_comment: Food groups (ADR 0061, Vintage Story nutrition). Each group is a bar of 0..max points. Eating fills the groups in the food's items.json "nutrition" ({group: points}), else items[id] here; a food with neither falls back to the first tag rule that matches its tags, worth share x its hunger points (at least 1). Stale food gives half. Every bar drains one point per drain_s seconds at rest (faster when sprinting, swimming or cold, like hunger). A group at good or more counts as eaten well: two or more such groups raise max health by bonus_hp each (one food alone gives nothing). A group under empty costs penalty_hp, but max health never drops below min_health. start = the bars of a new player.

items._comment: Groups for foods other parts add, by item id, so their items.json lines stay theirs (an item's own "nutrition" wins). Part F: cured meat and fish, flatbread, einkorn, emmer; part E: wild foods and fish.
